newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-DAY FIVE SNIPPETS FROM ROLAND GARROS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-DAY FIVE SNIPPETS FROM ROLAND GARROS.

text.p: A brief selection of highlights from the fifth day of the French Open:

Best quote - "It's funny, they keep asking me for my badge when I walk in the alleys. I'm the champion and they still want to see my badge. It's the same with the crowd, they always seem to support the other guy." Yevgeny Kafelnikov reflecting on life as defending champion at Roland Garros.
Stat of the day - 1. The number of men's top seeds to have won the French Open singles since 1987. Jim Courier in 1992.

French lessons - Michael Chang could reach the last 16 on Saturday having encountered only French opponents. He plays Stephane Simian in the third round, having already accounted for Rodolphe Gilbert and Jerome Golmard.
